definitions.explanation: the side that is to the left when facing forward

examples.japanese: {左側|ひだりがわ}を{歩|ある}いてください。
examples.english: Please walk on the left side.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}は{道|みち}の{左側|ひだりがわ}にあります。
examples.english: The station is on the left side of the road.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{車|くるま}は{道路|どうろ}の{左側|ひだりがわ}を{走|はし}ることになっている。
examples.english: In Japan, cars are supposed to drive on the left side of the road.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {左|ひだり} (left) and {側|がわ} (side). Used for spatial orientation, giving directions, and describing positions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左側|ひだりがわ}に{曲|ま}がる: to turn to the left side
- {左側|ひだりがわ}を{通|とお}る: to pass on the left
- {左側通行|ひだりがわつうこう}: left-side traffic
- {道|みち}の{左側|ひだりがわ}: the left side of the road

RELATED WORDS:
- {右側|みぎがわ}: right side — the opposite direction
- {左手|ひだりて}: left hand; can also mean "on one's left"
- {左|ひだり}: left — the basic directional word without specifying "side"
